title: Ron Tototz in the surf at Nha Trang
description: Ron Tototz walks up the sand out of heavy churned surf at Nha Trang beach, near beach hut #3 or #4 — the hut run by two girls selling soda pop, beer, and shrimp. Larry attaches a darker memory to this stretch of water: a medic from Nebraska went out into it and disappeared.
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0021-c18032383.json). The drowned medic has been searched for comprehensively and NOT found (2026-08-16, unresolved question #14): all 399 Nebraska casualties in the NARA DCAS list and every drowning in the full 58,220-record file were checked, and no casualty matches Nebraska + medic + drowned inside Larry’s window. The search record and the possible explanations — "from Nebraska" may not be home of record, "medic" may be Larry’s gloss, or the date may drift — are in research/people/drowned-medic-nha-trang.md. Confirms the survey's Nha Trang hypothesis for this beach series.
